# Advanced ChordGun + Borrowed Chords
A fork of del-paso's Advanced ChordGun (itself inspired by Pandabot's ChordGun) that adds out-of-scale chord suggestions. Installs next to the original and shares its per-project settings.
## Added in this fork
- OUT OF SCALE panel above the grid, in its own magenta frame: borrowed triads from the parallel scales (bII Phr, IV Maj ...), secondary dominants (V7/x) and the tritone substitute (subV7), with the same next-chord tint as the grid - Way back: after an out-of-scale chord the grid is re-scored for resolution; the diatonic chords it resolves to get a cyan outline - OUT OF SCALE badge and marked chord tones for any chord with outside notes - Harmonic Minor and Melodic Minor scales - Flat note names (Names: Auto / # / b)
## From the original
- 50+ chord types on a scrollable grid, every type on every scale degree - Next-chord suggestion tint, current chord highlight and chord trail - Arpeggiate mode with Round Robin humanize - Per-degree key bindings with octave offset and inversion, drag to assign - 3-octave chord finder piano - Adjustable text size (S/M/L/XL); settings persist with the project
## Keyboard Shortcuts
- 1-7: Play assigned chord for that scale degree - 0: Stop all notes - A: Toggle arpeggiate - B: Toggle the OUT OF SCALE panel - Up/Down: Scroll grid - Esc: Close
## Source
https://github.com/amenonegames/AdvancedChordGun (original: https://github.com/del-paso/AdvancedChordGun)
